lex: Lex `input` for import and export statements, returning the detected `imports` and `exports`.
Import: An import detected in the source. `type` is a combination of the `lex.constants` flags (e.g. `REQUIRE`, `IMPORT`, `DYNAMIC`); `position` holds the offsets `[importStart, specifierStart, specifierEnd]`.
Export: An export detected in the source; `position` holds the offsets `[exportStart, nameStart, nameEnd]`.
